
DESCRIPTION
Manage optional continuous integration

USAGE
  one ci [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  disable        Disable continuous integration
  enable         Enable continuous integration
  sync           Refresh continuous-integration configuration

EXAMPLES
  one ci
  one ci enable web
  one ci sync
  one ci disable web

TIPS
Shows and manages optional continuous integration. Workspaces and projects do not enable it automatically; the current build supports GitHub Actions.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
